support_bodies.name: west Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The -X rail's broad, flat slide-head underside is the Z seam's one down-looking face on this floor-down piece. Lifting a seated back-top lands that piece's flat foot on this complete bearing plane. Its two interface islands are the one run either side of the required 12 mm PRV passage; that opening also lets the support body root on the bed outside the flank instead of on the arm's under-flare.

support_bodies.name: west handhold lifting ceiling
support_bodies.rationale: The handhold keeps a flat bearing ceiling for upward finger contact, with 12 mm of roof section above it. This support reaches the back half of that ceiling from the print bed through the open bottom, with 34.20 mm of build-up. The opening gives direct access to remove the complete body.

support_bodies.name: east Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The +X rail's broad, flat slide-head underside mirrors the west one and remains continuous because nothing crosses this flank. With no opening through the wall beside it, the support has no lane to the bed and roots on the arm's own 45 degree under-flare 8.00 mm below the bearing plane.

support_bodies.name: pump-bay lintel
support_bodies.rationale: The fixed roof carries the display and ridge wall above the cartridge withdrawal envelope. Its flat underside is accessible through the empty cartridge bay for support removal.

support_bodies.name: flush-grip guides, internal rim ceilings, spring bores, web bearings, well crowns and pump-jack roof
support_bodies.rationale: The cup guides and internal retaining rims retain their flat sliding ceilings. Their broad recesses admit the complete grips from inside the enclosure and open onto the tee wells. The spring bores guide the return pair, the upper web bearings capture the carrier, and the keyed pump-jack roof retains its plug. Remove this connected support through the empty cartridge bay, aft carrier recess and tee wells before installing hardware.

support_bodies.name: X- pump boss-bearing shoulder
support_bodies.rationale: The flat annular shoulder bears axially on the fitted pump boss while the complete octagonal wall locates X, Y and yaw. Chamfering the shoulder would trade away bearing area rather than remove an accidental overhang; its centre bore remains open for direct support removal.

support_bodies.name: X- pump-cartridge pull roof
support_bodies.rationale: The pull keeps a flat roof at the neighboring tee-carrier grip's roof plane because both faces carry the same squeeze motion. One tree reaches that roof from the print bed through the open side pocket after 51.00 mm of build-up; the complete body is directly accessible for removal.

support_bodies.name: closed finger-pocket roof
support_bodies.rationale: The pocket roof is the common hand-contact plane shared with the cartridge pull. Its rounded mouth gives direct access to remove this support from the loose half.

support_bodies.name: internal rim and seam-rail relief
support_bodies.rationale: The retaining rim and grip root share a flat lower face above the enclosure seam rail. The 6 mm outer cup floor remains bedded. Support under the inboard relief and projecting rim ends is directly accessible on the loose half before it enters the enclosure.

support_bodies.rationale: The lap has a flat fastening section above the tee run ends. Its underside is carried by a bed-rooted support removed from the open center end before joining the carrier halves.
